<!-- pr-reviewer: 0a4461fac8f8562a17cf11c036e578dbb11bac91 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge - after #466** (this branch carries #466's commits; the trial merge against current main is clean, but merge #466 first so the diff shrinks to the #355 change).

**What looks good**
- MCP tools and `cam.exportTools` / `cam.importTools` share one implementation via the VERBS table; `cam.d.ts` matches it.
- Import runs through the undoable `ImportTools` command (one undo step); refusals are tool errors, with no unwrap/expect/panic or unchecked casts in the added src lines.
- Provenance lines on new modules, a decisions file, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #355` present. No `build.rs`, `.github`, script or dependency changes.

**Local results (trial merge with upstream/main, clean, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp` | 13 passed |
| `--test tool_library` | 12 passed |
| `--test scripting` | 18 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

UI suites not run here (UI change is #466's). `egui_tool_editor.png` snapshot changed; pixel diffs on another OS would be a platform artifact.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` is 1892 lines (already over the ~400 guide; small growth only).
- Re-import duplicate detection by name ("B (3)") is recorded in the decisions file; fine as a follow-up.
- The stdio `camcraft-cli mcp` binary was not driven by a real client (as the PR says).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
